Tim was the first to awaken, Mikey's arms caressing him as Mikey lay asleep. An aroma of sweat and weed filled the apartment. Tim felt at ease, and happy, despite the dire situation that had been thrust upon the two. Tim knew this peace couldn't last, long and began packing things the two would need. The rustling awoke Mikey. He stood from the bed, yawning. A horrified look crept up on his face...

"Tim, why the fuck was I in your bed? Did you drug me!?"

Tim quickly walked into the bedroom and replied,

"Mikey, don't you remember last night??"

This perplexed and angered Mikey,

"Who the fuck is Mikey?! Why are you calling me that? I'm Derek"

Tim panicked, was this actually Derek or was it Derek's personality and memories taking over. Regardless of either, he needed an excuse, since Derek could easily overpower him.

"Sorry, slip of the tongue. Derek, you smoked a little too much weed last night and passed out in my bed, don't worry I slept on the couch."

Derek thought about the plausibility of this scenario, but then realized he had was supposed to make some sales and meet up with his girlfriend the night before.

"Fuck, I don't have time to debate what did or didn't happen last night, I need to go ASAP. Shit 6 missed calls from my girl last night! If I find out you fucked me over, you're so dead."

Derek began getting dressed and checking his numerous texts. Tim began to worry, trying to figure out a way to reach Mikey. He began to stall for time,

"Sure you don't want to stay for breakfast? I make a mean omelet! "

Derek scoffed,

"What do I look like, your boyfriend? I'm leaving right now."

BANG BANG BANG

"Open up, this is SHIELD, we will enter with force if necessary"

Just as things were looking bleak, Tim had an idea...

"You have to the count of 3 to open this door: 3"

Tim grabbed his backpack and ran up to Derek,

"Mikey, I love you."

And before a moment passed, Tim opened the window and started climbing down the fire escape.

"2"

A internal war began battling in Derek's mind, he was sure he was Derek, but why had those words left such a strong impact on him.

"1"

CRASH! The door was busted down, SHIELD agents filed into the apartment, holding Derek at gunpoint. Derek seemed trapped within his own thoughts, despite weapons being pointed at his face.

"Where is Timothy Jacobs?!"

Roared one of the SHIELD agents. No words reciprocated the question, only the blank stare of a catatonic trance.

"I guess we're doing this the hard way, bring him in for questioning."

As Derek was being handcuffed, he blinked...

Mikey opened his eyes and felt what could only be described as a blistering hangover. His head wasn't spinning and he wasn't in pain, but he felt as if he had been pull out of a void, and attempting to access his memories brought on a mountain of confusion. He was in Tim's alleyway, sweating balls. Mikey did remember one thing from this morning, Tim professing his love for Mikey. Mikey was then immediately aware of his situation, because he had three memories of that moment. The first was a deep anger at Tim for professing love to his drug dealer, the second was a emotional tidal wave of joy, happiness, and love for Tim, and the third was a scheme to draw Mikey out of Derek and into himself. Mikey immediately realized that he was Tim again, and this time it was planned, he planned it, or he had memories of planning it that weren't his, but were now. Other memories of the plan began to become clear. He needed to get under the radar and meet up with Tim's old hacking group, ROFLsec. Mikey, now Tim, left the alleyway and began to blend into the crowd.

As Mikey paced himself towards larger and larger crowds, he realized, through Tim's memories, that there was a burner cell phone in his pocket, ready to be used. Like he had been Tim his entire life, he pull out the phone and dialed Maddy's number:

"Maddy I need a pickup stat"

Mikey and Maddy set a plan for the pickup.

"We'll be there in 10, Tim, are you OK? This sounds serious"

Maddy had no idea,

"It is, but I can't tell you now, just get us to the ROFLsec safe house and we'll talk."

Mikey quickly destroyed the phone and threw it on the ground. It had served its purpose.

During Mikey's wait he remembered that he had packed a change of clothes into the bag. He knew he was probably seen by multiple security cameras during his escape, and thought it was a good time if any to change now. Mikey had stopped trying to differentiate memories, this was not the time to be contemplative, regardless of the repercussions it might bring. He put on a pair of shades and walked to the pick up location. He became horny as he began the trek, donning Tim's shades, changing into his clothes, and sharing his memories made him feel a closeness to Tim he had never felt before, and it was showing - literally. Since he was slowly diving into Tim's persona, it also made him feel awkward to be turned on by himself. Mikey knew that Tim came up with this plan on the spot so that Mikey would have access to it after the swap. It was a selfless act to save Mikey, since Tim would now be cooped up in a S.H.I.E.L.D facility, being interrogated. Mikey wanted to run away from all this, and maybe he still did, but now that Tim was in legitimate trouble at his expense, he was determined to save him.

The plan for the pickup was set, there was a bakery that had a hard to find back door to a coffee shop with a public balcony for patrons to enjoy their morning joes. Mikey would wait on this balcony for Maddy to get him and walk him to the car in a nearby street. This was a unnecessarily complicated plan, but that's what made Maddy so brilliant - she would always plan for the worst. Mikey knew this had saved his, or Tim's, ass multiple times, he wasn't quite sure which. It would be very hard to tail Mikey to the car this way. So with that in mind, Mikey used this back door to the coffee shop and waited on the balcony for Maddy. Mikey was slightly taken aback when Gabriel showed up in place of Maddy. Gabriel had been a on-off lover of Maddy's, and last he had heard she was dumping him for cheating on her, what she didn't know was that he was cheating on her with Tim. He was also a fantastic hardware hacker who brought essential skills to ROFLsec. The social implications of the relationship weighed on Mikey, but he was too aroused to let it bother him to much. He knew this was Tim's memory because he had never been able to come out of the closet, and he wouldn't have the balls to score a guy like Gabriel.

"Hey Hotshot, it's time to go."

Gabriel told Mikey with a wink. Mikey followed him, trying his hardest to ensure he didn't accidentally swap with Gabriel. Even though Mikey wasn't certain, he believed it took a little while to gain access to memories when first becoming someone. It happened quickly with Tim, but he had swapped with him once before, and maybe since they were close friends it didn't take as long for it to happen. In any case, Mikey needed to make sure he didn't swap with Gabriel and forget the directions to the pickup spot. He repressed the memories of the times Tim and Gabriel spent together... at least for now. As they were walking towards the car's location, Gabriel paused and pulled out his smartphone.

"Stop for a second, see that security camera over there?"

Mikey looked up at the camera and nodded.

"Gabe, why would you plan a route with a security camera?"

Gabriel grew a mischievous grin.

"I installed a backdoor on this camera, we can go through undetected - but I think it would be more fun to do something else. Follow me."

Gabriel tapped on his smart phone and they walked pass the view of the camera.

"Ok, now let's walk back that way again."

Mikey scoffed,

"C'mon Gabe, we're wasting time."

Gabriel ignored the comment tapped on his smartphone again and lead Mikey back they way the came.

"Ok, last time passed the security camera."

Mikey scoffed harder this time. Gabriel felt the need to justify the mean girls look Mikey was giving him.

"Ah, ruin the fun, fine. off, on ,off"

Gabriel mimed along to the on off sentiment, Mikey caught on. Gabriel turned off the camera when they walked by the first time, turned on the camera when they walked the other way, and turned it off again for the final trip. Mikey understood, Gabriel was essentially making it look like they were walking the opposite direction, a pretty clever move. They walked for a few more minutes until finally reaching the car.

"Get In"

Maddy said quickly, trying to be discrete. Mikey didn't need to be told twice, he jumped in the car and they quickly drove away
